newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sammi Steel limit-down on trouble talk.
newsitem.headline: Sammi Steel limit-down on trouble talk.

text.p: Shares of Sammi Steel, a specialty steel products maker, went limit-down early on Wedesday on market talk that the company faced financial trouble, brokers said.
According to the market talk, Sammi has been seeking $700 million loans from the Korea Development Bank (KDB) to meet its operating expenses and investment plans.

"This seems to fuel the speculation of the financial difficulties. Other rumours say say Sammi is threatening to file for a court receivership unless the loans are secured," said a Daishin Securities broker.
Sammi officials declined comment on talk it was seeking loans.
The company issued a statement saying the rumour that it sought court receivership was groundless.
